# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Security fixes are applied to the latest release line.

| Version | Supported |
|---|---|
| `0.2.x` | Yes |
| `0.1.x` and earlier | No |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/bharathadigopula/terraform-oci-modules/security/advisories/new) to report suspected vulnerabilities.

Do not disclose vulnerability details in a public issue. Include the affected module and version, reproduction steps, impact, and any suggested mitigation.
